- GCC customers can manage tenants in the Commercial cloud.
Some of the key benefits you get with multitenant management for Defender XDR and the
Microsoft Sentinel in the Defender portal include:
A centralized place to manage incidents and cases across tenants: A unified view
provides SOC analysts with all the information they need to investigate incidents and
cases across multiple tenants, eliminating the need to sign in and out of each one.
Streamlined threat hunting: Multi-tenancy support enables SOC teams use Microsoft
Defender XDR advanced hunting capabilities to create Kusto Query Language (KQL)
queries that proactively hunt for threats across multiple tenants.
Multi-customer management for partners: Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP)
partners can now gain visibility into cases, security incidents, alerts, and threat hunting
across multiple customers through a single pane of glass.
The following key capabilities are available for each tenant you have access to in multitenant
management for Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel in the Defender portal:
